scientific_limitations: Complete exact classification only for binary Hamming cubes in dimensions 3 through 5 and inclusive scale 2; pair distances 1,2 and n=3 boundary included as known consequences, not novel. title: Two-point deletion homotopy profiles of Hamming-scale-two cube complexes through dimension five
